original_title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Passes 1 Million Copies Sold in Just 2 Days

en.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Sells 1 Million Copies in Just 48 Hours
en.summary: Rebel Wolves' ambitious dark fantasy RPG, The Blood of Dawnwalker, has stormed the market, achieving a staggering 1 million copies sold within its first two days of release. This massive debut marks an incredible start for the new IP and its fledgling development studio.
en.body:
The gaming world is abuzz as **Rebel Wolves**' debut title, **The Blood of Dawnwalker**, has shattered expectations, selling over 1 million copies in a mere 48 hours since its launch on September 3, 2026. This monumental achievement for a brand-new intellectual property and a studio founded just in 2022 speaks volumes about the anticipation and reception of this dark fantasy action RPG. Available on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S, the game plunges players into a grim, 14th-century European setting.

Developed by a team helmed by industry veteran Konrad Tomaszkiewicz, who previously directed **The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt** and co-directed **Cyberpunk 2077**, **The Blood of Dawnwalker** centers on Coen, a protagonist who navigates a dual existence as a human by day and a vampire by night. The narrative promises a deeply personal journey, focusing on Coen's fight to protect his family, with player choices significantly shaping the unfolding story. The game features an in-game clock that compresses its main narrative into a 30-day cycle, a mechanic that has already sparked discussion among players.

> "Thank you for playing, sharing, supporting, and being part of the community!" — Rebel Wolves

This rapid sales success is particularly noteworthy given that **Rebel Wolves** is a first-time developer. The studio's ambitious vision was hinted at in earlier CGI teasers, suggesting a vast dark fantasy saga with potential for expansion. Bandai Namco's involvement as publisher has undoubtedly provided a strong foundation, but the raw appeal of the game's premise and execution has clearly resonated with a global audience eager for fresh, mature storytelling in the RPG genre.

## A New Challenger Enters the Dark Fantasy Arena

The immediate success of **The Blood of Dawnwalker** is a testament to the power of experienced leadership combined with a compelling new vision. For fans of dark fantasy and narrative-driven RPGs, this title offers a unique blend of historical setting and supernatural intrigue. The concept of a human by day and vampire by night, set against the backdrop of medieval Europe, provides fertile ground for complex moral choices and intense combat. The game's focus on player agency, where actions have tangible consequences, is a hallmark of critically acclaimed RPGs, and its early sales suggest this approach is a winning formula.

## Community Embraces the Dawnwalker's Curse

The enthusiastic response from the community, evidenced by the million-copy milestone within two days, highlights a strong appetite for this kind of experience. Social media channels and gaming forums are already alight with discussions about Coen's journey, the game's atmosphere, and the potential for future installments. The fact that this is a new IP, unburdened by established lore but also without a pre-existing fanbase, makes this launch all the more impressive. It suggests **Rebel Wolves** has not only captured the attention of established RPG enthusiasts but has also managed to create a compelling new world that players are eager to explore and invest in.

## What's Next for Coen and Rebel Wolves

With this explosive start, all eyes are now on **Rebel Wolves** and Bandai Namco to see how **The Blood of Dawnwalker** continues to perform and evolve. Further details on potential post-launch content, expansions, or even hints at future chapters in the saga are eagerly awaited by the growing player base. The studio has already indicated a long-term vision for this dark fantasy universe.

content_raw: Single-player RPG and new IP The Blood of Dawnwalker has sold 1 million copies just two days after its launch, publisher Bandai Namco and developer Rebel Wolves have announced. Official social media accounts for the first-time developer's new game confirmed the news with a celebratory graphic today. The milestone was reached just 48 hours after The Blood of Dawnwalker launched for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S September 3. "Thank you for playing, sharing, supporting, and being part of the community!" Rebel Wolves said in a message to fans. Thank you for playing, sharing, supporting, and being part of the community! ❤ pic.twitter.com/9fNqO8gNGB — Dawnwalker (@DawnwalkerGame) September 5, 2026 An official summary for The Blood of Dawnwalker describes it as an "open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe." In this first chapter, players take the role of Coen, a "human by day and vampire by night" who is fighting for his family in a narrative shaped by player choice. It also happens to have an in-game clock that sees Coen's story take place through a 30-day period . It's something some players love – and others don't . Reaching 1 million copies sold in such a short amount of time would be an impressive feat for any game, but there are a few reasons it's especially noteworthy for the Rebel Wolves team. This is the studio's first major release since it was founded in 2022 . Led by The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt director and Cyberpunk 2077 co-director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz, The Blood of Dawnwalker is also a new IP. The Warsaw-based studio previously released a CGI teaser to tease how sequels could potentially expand on its dark fantasy formula in new and interesting ways. "The CGI teaser shows where the dark fantasy saga is heading," Bandai Namco said in a June press release. "Players can see Coen in completely different surroundings than the ones they are used to – a modern, 21st-century setting, offering a glimpse of where the overarching plot ultimately leads. As the developers revealed, the next installments of the Dawnwalker franchise will span centuries, continents, and cultures across the globe." Surreal. Thank you so much!🔥🙏 — Mateusz Tomaszkiewicz 🧛‍♂️ (@MTomaszkiewicz) September 5, 2026 Speechless. Proud. Tearing up a little 🥹 We're a passionate bunch. And we're not stopping here 😤 Thank you for trusting us ❤️ — Paweł BANAN Panasiuk 🍌 (@pawpanasiuk) September 5, 2026 Tomaszkiewicz said at the time that each installment in the Dawnwalker series is planned to be a standalone entry "with its own story, without narrative cliffhangers, unresolved plot threads, or time travel ideas." With 1 million copies in players' hands out of the gate, those sequels already feel more likely to materialize. Although the when and where for these planned follow-ups have yet to be revealed, narrative director Jakub Szamałek has at least told fans to keep an eye out for "breadcrumbs related to the overarching plot spanning
